data.body:
**[P2] Set the telemetry polling budget explicitly**

This constructor inherits the base core's 120-second polling timeout, and `fetch_records` supplies no `completion_check`. Consequently, even an immediately available valid record requires approximately 130 seconds with the default pre-wait, rather than the documented ten-second polling window. Set an explicit telemetry polling budget; if retaining a longer budget, provide a validation completion predicate that respects the retriever's settling period. Add a fake-clock test using the real retriever to cover this lifecycle.
